notes.title: Mini-Game Skip & Russian Language Support & more!
notes.content:
[b]I'm excited to deliver the first major update news from "Gears Story"![/b]

[h1]Mini-Game Skip Feature[/h1]

The mini-games, long criticized for their redundancy, can finally be skipped.

The function of the highest-priced item, the "Golden Wrench", has been changed as follows:
[list][*]Before: The path to the goal is visualized for 100 moves.
[*]After: Becomes inoperable and automatically moves to the goal.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44877675/2fa5ed90beee92d60a68c6f0720a3b9ec4ad727a.gif[/img]

[h1]Tips Tree Feature Added[/h1]

I have changed the display of the massive number of tips items to a tree view, categorized for easier browsing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44877675/be75beed0af67002c22c2f1be08231662dd2cbbd.png[/img]

[h1]Support for Russian Language[/h1]

I have added Russian to the languages supported.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44877675/89a5f840793944719c81c38427bc3ae92d24add7.png[/img]

[h1]Main Visual Change[/h1]

The main visual of the game has been updated with newly drawn pixel art.
Here is the full image.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44877675/ff453399ebd4022d82230dc9ef7b6590578ddeba.png[/img]

notes.title: Soundtrack Release!!
notes.content:
The soundtrack of "Gears Story", "KITTYPOOL's O.S.T. All In One", is now available for purchase!


[h1]Every single piece of music from past to future KITTYPOOL productions is included![/h1]


"KITTYPOOL's O.S.T. All In One" contains all the music used in past KITTYPOOL games, as well as all the music that will be used in all future KITTYPOOL games.


As new songs are added in the future, the price is expected to increase accordingly, so it's a great deal to buy early!


"KITTYPOOL's O.S.T. All In One":
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2896100/KITTYPOOLs_OST_All_In_One/

notes.title: 1.0.2 Hot Fix
notes.content:
Here are the details of the 1.0.2 Hot Fix:

[list]
[*] Fixed typos in the English Tips.
[*] Clarified the confusing expressions regarding the price in the "Afterword."
[*] Corrected parts where the BGM that should play in reverse during subconscious scenes was not.
[*] Fixed the issue where pressing the enter key could advance dialogue even in moments when dialogue should not be advanced.
[/list]
